question: Should OpenClaw add HEARTBEAT.md task-level model metadata, route this through a broader model-routing API, or keep heartbeat routing whole-turn only?
rationale: Source inspection proves the capability is missing, but the implementation shape changes public heartbeat syntax and model/session routing behavior, so automation cannot safely choose the product contract.

options.title: Design shared routing contract first
options.body: Keep this open and define a reusable heartbeat or per-turn routing contract before accepting a heartbeat-only model field.

options.title: Add heartbeat-only task metadata
options.body: Implement a narrow HEARTBEAT.md model field with explicit due-task splitting, alias/fallback/auth behavior, docs, and regression tests.

options.title: Keep routing whole-turn only
options.body: Decline per-task core syntax and document that plugins may route an entire heartbeat turn through before_model_resolve, accepting that batched due tasks share one model.

recommendation.title: Design shared routing contract first
recommendation.body: Keep this open and define a reusable heartbeat or per-turn routing contract before accepting a heartbeat-only model field.

likelyOwner.reason: He is tied to the model-hook seam and related product-boundary decisions that determine whether this belongs in core heartbeat syntax or plugin/API routing.
